== Ōi Shrines List ==
* {{ill|Ōi Shrine (Mito)|ja|大井神社 (水戸市)}}（{{ill|Ibaraki Prefecture|en|Ibaraki Prefecture|qid=Q83273|lt=Ibaraki}} [[Mito, Ibaraki|Mito City]]） - A Shikinaisha (式内社) candidate shrine. The enshrined deity Kashima-no-Mikoto (建借馬命) had the former name Ōfu-no-Omi (意富臣), which later became "Ōi" through phonetic changes.
